lines.text: Joshua builds an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal.
Following the Book of the Law, Joshua builds the altar of uncut stones, and they offer burnt and peace offerings.
In front of the Israelites, Joshua inscribes on the stones a copy of the law of Moses.
All Israel stands on both sides of the ark, half facing Mount Sinai and half facing Mount Ebal.
Joshua reads all the law, blessings and curses, to the whole assembly, including the women and the kings.
